product.name: Starknet
product.description: A permissionless Layer 2 blockchain that uses STARK proofs to scale Ethereum transactions while supporting smart contracts written in Cairo.

product.name: StarkEx
product.description: A scalable validity-proof service for deploying application-specific Layer 2 systems and processing transactions with cryptographic proofs verified on Ethereum.

product.name: Cairo
product.description: A programming language and development ecosystem for writing provable programs and smart contracts that can run on Starknet and other STARK-based systems.

product.name: STARK Proving and Verification Stack
product.description: Cryptographic infrastructure for generating and verifying STARK proofs of computational integrity, enabling scalable blockchain execution and data processing.
